title: Coupling between Phase Separation and Geometry on a Closed Elastic Curve: Free Energy Minimization and Dynamics
summary: We study the free energy and dynamics of a closed elastic filament (a one-dimensional curve in two dimensions) coupled to a scalar concentration field representing, for example, an absorbed species. The density variable has a tendency to phase-separate whereas the local spontaneous curvature is concentration-dependent.
